newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks extend gains on finance buying.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks extend gains on finance buying.

text.p: Thai stocks extended their gains early Friday trade on sustained buying of finance shares, brokers said.
At 0322 GMT, the composite SET index was 1.98 points higher to 651.31 on 971 million baht turnover.
"There was buying interest in finance issues especially in five finance companies who are expected to receive the bank licenses," said one broker at Asia Securities Trading.
Gainers led decliners 102 to 59 with 46 counters steady.
Philippine peso jitters had no impact on the market.
